name: Cursed Seal Sasuke
functionDesc: Being cursed by Orochimaru's Cursed Seal of Heaven,  Sasabe's body is covered with the flame-like marks and his skin turns into gray. A cross-shaped mark appears in the middle of his face, and his hair grows.  A pair of webbed-claw-shaped wings grow out from his back, with these wings he can fly in the sky.

name: Shisui the Teleporter
functionDesc: Renowned as Shisui of the Body Flicker, he was Itachi Uchiha's best friend and instructor, possessed the most powerful dojutsu Koto Amatsukami. His two eyes contains different abilities, and is granted with the ultimate ability Susanoo when the power of Mangekyo Sharingan is awakened.

name: Six Paths Madara
functionDesc: The strongest ninja in the Uchiha Clan. After being summoned by the reanimation jutsu, he absorbed the 10-Tails who revived again, and became the 10-Tailed Jinchuriki and the third Sage of the Six Paths.

name: Asura · Naruto
functionDesc: Naruto and Sasuke were sent to the normal space by the Sage of the Six Paths after Kaguya was sealed. Naruto bowed farewell to his father. The Sage of the Six Paths hoped that they could help open the Ultimate Tsukuyomi. However, Sasuke suddenly claimed to complete his objective on his own. Sakura wanted to stop him, but she was too enchanted by Sasuke to make him listen. Finally, Naruto and Sasuke returned to the Valley of The End and a fight started. The fight ended with each arm of both fighters broken. Sasuke was finally touched by Naruto's kindness and accepted that he was defeated by Naruto.

name: White Strength Sakura
functionDesc: Sakura's attack form after releasing the 100 Healings skill. Cursed seals appear on Sakura's body, which allows Sakura to destroy the Uchiha clan's Absolute Defense, Susanoo.

name: Indra·Sasuke
functionDesc: Sasuke Uchiha is the second and last Reincarnation of Indra. He is a friend of Asura Naruto, but they often fight each other. After the battle in The Valley of the End, they became to understand each other and ended the their Samsara. That is why there are no other Chakra reincarnations in the world.

name: Reanimated Itachi
functionDesc: Itachi was reanimated by Kabuto. Itachi managed to get rid of Kabuto's control with Shisui Uchiha's Sharingan that had been given to him. Itachi defeated Kabuto with the ultimate dojutsu Izanami.

name: Reanimated Nagato
functionDesc: A descendant of the Uzumaki clan, the leader of both Akatsuki and Amegakure. He was summoned by Kabuto with the reanimation jutsu and acted together with Uchiha Itachi after the Fourth Shinobi War. He became young after absorbing Killer B's 8-tailed Chakra with the Preta Path.

name: Ohtsutsuki Kaguya
functionDesc: The incarnation of the Divine Tree, the creator of the ninja world, the ancestor of Chakra, and mother of the Sage of the Six Paths, Kaguya possessed three dojutsu – Byakugan, Sharingan and Rinnegan. She was worshipped as the Rabbit Goddess by the world, because she ended wars. However, she was sealed by her own child. Later, Kaguya was revived by using Madara's body and unlocked a huge Truth-Seeking Ball, attempting to create the world again in the showdown. However, with mutual efforts, Naruto and Sasuke stopped her by releasing the Six Paths•Planetary Devastation.

name: Otsutsuki Toneri
functionDesc: Hamura Otsutsuki's descendant, once sent his puppet army to attack Hyuga Hinata. He thought the world created by the Sage of the Six Paths is a failure, and intended to awaken the Tenseigan, controlling meteor crashes to destroy earth. After being defeated by Naruto, he learnt Hamura's true intention and returned to the moon.

name: Otsutsuki Hamura
functionDesc: Hamura was the son of Kaguya Otsutsuki‎‎ and Hagoromo Otsutsuki's brother. He inherited the bloodline ability, Byakugan from his mother. Hamura once defeated and sealed the Ten-Tails with his brother. After the ninja war, he became the leader of the Otsutsuki Clan. In order to watch the Gedo Statue, he and his clansmen moved to the moon where Chibaku Tensei was generated.

name: Rashomon·Orochimaru
functionDesc: Orochimaru summons Rashomon from hell, which provides a greater defense.

name: Hinata Uzumaki
functionDesc: The Seventh Hokage's wife, Hinata Uzumaki as a member of the Hyuga clan, she possesses Byakugan. She can release chakra from her body to launch powerful attacks, such as the Eight Trigrams: Twin Lions Crumbling Attack.

name: The Rabbit Goddess
functionDesc: Kaguya Otsutsuki‎‎, as the princess of the Otsutsuki clan, was born with Byakugan. After obtaining the fruit of the Shinju, she possessed god-like power. She was worshipped as the Rabbit Goddess. Driven by her lust for power, she released Rinne Sharingan on ordinary people. And since then, she is no longer treated as a goddess but a demon.

name: Shin Uchiha
functionDesc: Shin did not belong to the Uchiha Clan. He changed his surname to Uchiha because he was so obsessed with Itachi Uchiha. Like Sasuke Uchiha, he misunderstood  Itachi's intentions, and thought that humans would only evolve in war rather than peace.

name: Sand Burial·Gaara
functionDesc: Sand Burial·Gaara is a ninja from Sand Village. He was ruthless and bloodthirsty before meeting Naruto because he was regarded as a monster by villagers. He felt betrayed by his family with Shukaku sealed inside the body. After the battle with Naruto, he changed. Now, he is leading and protecting his village as the fifth Kazekage.

name: Reanimated Hiruzen
functionDesc: Hiruzen died in the Fourth Shinobi War and was reanimated by Orochimaru to fight with the other three Hokages.

name: Naruto & Hinata
functionDesc: Naruto's dream finally comes true. He becomes the Seventh Hokage and marries Hinata. However, it isn't the end. As the Seventh Hokage, he inherits the Will of Fire and promises to protect his village and work for peace.

name: Sasuke & Itachi
functionDesc: "Forgive me, Sasuke! This is the last time." Sasuke who was desperate saw that familiar gesture and the smile again: pressing Sasuke's forehead with his fingertip. Eventually, Sasuke understood Itachi and inherited his will. The bond between bothers turned into fire that burned down everything.

name: Kakashi & Gai
functionDesc: Kakashi and Gai were destined to be lifetime opponents. They always acted like they hated each other but when the moment that decides life and death came, they would rescue each other without hesitation. Opponents can drive people to surpass themselves. People without opponents are lonely, especially ninjas.

name: Madara & Obito
functionDesc: “Launch the Infinite Tsukuyomi with the chakra of the Ten Tails to create an ideal world where no war is waged and Rin will be back to life.  "Madara taught Obito Yin-Yang Shield and Six Paths Techniques, and formed Black Zetsu by infusing his will into White Zetsu to assist Obito. Thus, Obito put on Madara's mask and took his name. In the name of Madara, he created Akatsuki.

name: Deidara & Sasori
functionDesc: The youngest member  in "Akatsuki" team. He is usually quoting "Art is an Explosion!" He has long blond hair which he wore drawn into a half ponytail with the rest hanging down freely and covers his left face.  In his two palms, there are two mouths.He is Chiyo's grandson, also known as Sasori of the Red Sand. Characterized by red hair, and has been transformed into a puppet body. He believes "Art is eternal beauty forever", which is totally different from Deidara's concept "Art is the eternal beauty illusion".

name: Minato & Kushina
functionDesc: Minato, the Fourth Hokage and Kushina, the Nine-tailed Jinchuriki were destined to live an unusual life with their son. Minato decided to seal the Nine-tails inside his son's body. They pinned their spirits of perseverance and braveness on their son, Uzumaki Naruto.

name: Naruto & Sasuke
functionDesc: The reincarnations of Asura and Indra. The reincarnations of each life are meant to become lifelong rivals and friends. They always repeat the fate of Asura and Indra. After the battle of the Valley of the End, Naruto and Sasuke acknowledge each other and break the circle of fate. Therefore, after them, the chakras and souls of Indra and Asura will no longer be reborn into other people.
